notes.title: Shroued in Sanity now on Xbox, Playstation4, and Nintendo Switch.
notes.content:
I can finally talk about this freely!

Shrouded in Sanity will release on all 3 mayor consoles at February 11th.
Additionally there will be a limited physical PS4 version released too.

Its been... over 6 years now, but SiS will finally see the light of day on consoles.
The port features some small QoL changes, some upgraded art assets, full achievement support, and most powerful of all, French, German, Italian, Spanish full localisation! (As well as a new kick ass art piece by Rock who did the character art for Usurper, and the cover art for Usurper, and Into the Fray.

PS4 trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TrINsKpaqS0

Xbox trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p2quDOiOjFM

Nintendo Switch:
https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/skautfold-shrouded-in-sanity-switch/

There are more exciting news for the future but I cant talk about those yet :P

notes.title: Moonless Knight release date!
notes.content:
October 31st 2019.

Yes, in two months.

I could release early October but I rather make sure I polish it up as much as possible. 
It already contains more options and comfort settings than all 3 of my games combined, which is hard as the engine can be a total headache.

Overall this game will feature the widest spectrum of gameplay styles of my games yet, with the absolute most open structure yet. More open than basically any Metroidvania, but not falling over the edge into open world.

Please look forward to the release and make sure to wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029170/Skautfold_Moonless_Knight/

It has been a really hard time for me both due to financial difficulties and struggling with depression, still I feel like this will be by far my best work yet.

notes.title: Into the Fray release date set.
notes.content:
[b]December 5th.[/b]

[i]Into the Fray[/i] will be leaving Early Access on the 5th of December.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

The game is a direct sequel to both [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] and [i]Usurper[/i], and features Hito the 3rd Knight as the protagonist.

The game will receive post launch support in the form of more modes and silly extras, but the release version will already feature a lot of extras. Like the obvious Steam stuff like Achievements and Trading cards.

Once out of EA development on the next game begins immediately, while ItF will receive periodic smaller additions to tie over. No DLC plans. If you are interested in the 4th game in the series you can always pop into our Discord and take a look and have your say, discord users had a lot of influence on me over the last game.

Additionally Christmas will bring a nice surprise regarding [i]Usurper[/i] if everything goes well, as a thank you to all who support my weird series of games with different genres each time.

notes.title: Sequel nearing release.
notes.content:
[b]Into the Fray[/b], the sequel to [b]Shrouded in Sanity[/b] and [b]Usurper[/b] is nearing its completion in Early Access: https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

Mandatory story content is nearly finished, and the gameplay is getting polished to a close to final version, an RPG mode was also implemented to make it more for for those who like to create builds.

Final release is expected in 2-3 weeks, with a lot of optional content and a lot of post release content planned, even the possibility of a 2 player local versus mode.

notes.title: Have your name in the next game...
notes.content:
The next game in the series is already far in development, so much like [i]Usurper[/i], the chance to have your name in this new game for free is here.


All you need to do is post a name you would like to see in the next game as the dog-tag of a fallen British soldier. 

Due to the setting, pretty much any name can work, so long as you keep within common sense. That means; no swearing, no derogatory language, and no names unique to copyrighted material. (i.e. no Darth Vader, Harry Potter etc.) 


So think of a name you'd like to see on a dog-tag, (nicknames work best) post it below, and the first 100 will appear in the game on fallen soldiers.

If you had your name already appear in Usurper, please try and pick a new one; those who died during Usurper are dead for good in canon. :)


Post your name here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/603020/announcements/detail/1681414626061814495


Thank you for the support, and look forward to the reveal of the next game in the [i]Skautfold[/i] series.

[i]Pugware[/i]

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: A doughty dozen new Steam games
notes.content:
We’re back!

Unknown Pleasures has been on unplanned hiatus as I have been grotesquely ill. The lack of communication or cover was entirely my fault, and I apologise for that unreservedly (and extend further thanks to the Hivemind for their extraordinary patience). I’m sorry.

Wait, hang on, Adam’s leaving. I can blame him! It was Adam, everyone! Shake your indignant fists.

There’s a bumper of 12 games this week, and then we’ll be back to normal. So, assaulting our ailing bodies this week: third party candidates, pugilistic ducks, and a JRPG that wait where are you going no come on, be fair.

(more…)
